description: TinySoftwareSerial receives through the analog comparator after Serial.begin(); input before it is discarded; parseInt skips non-digits and its 1 s timeout ends a number.
basis: ATTinyCore 1.5.2 TinySoftwareSerial.cpp: begin() enables the comparator interrupt (ACIE, bandgap against AIN1 = PB1); without it no byte is received; Stream::parseInt of the core: non-digits are discarded until a digit arrives, the 1 s timeout starts anew with every character, so "42" ends 1 s after its last digit (got 42 at about 1.3 s) and "7" at about 2.5 s; "9" arrives before Serial.begin() and is lost
